findings.title: Grafana list rules lose the pause action
findings.body: `GrafanaRuleListItem` now passes only `promRule` to `RuleActionsButtons`, so `rulerRule` is undefined for rules in the list. This condition therefore hides the pause action even when the Grafana Prometheus rule abilities allow pausing. Users can no longer pause or resume Grafana-managed rules from the list view.

findings.title: Delete is hidden for rules rendered from Prometheus data
findings.body: The new list item supplies `promRule` but no `rulerRule`, so this condition is always false for rules in the list. As a result, the Delete action is absent even when `canDelete` is true, removing the ability to delete Grafana-managed rules from the list view.

findings.title: Silence action opens no drawer for list rules
findings.body: The list now constructs `RuleActionsButtons` with only `promRule`, but the drawer is rendered only when `rule` is a Grafana ruler alerting rule. The menu can still show Silence based on the Prometheus rule abilities, so clicking it sets `showSilenceDrawer` without rendering anything; users see a working menu item that does nothing.

findings.title: Filtered Grafana rule items are missing React keys
findings.body: This `rules.map` branch renders `GrafanaRuleListItem` without the `key={key}` used by the neighboring branches. React will warn about missing keys and may reuse the wrong component instance when the filtered list changes, potentially carrying per-item UI state between rules.
